entities.summary: The Margraviate or Marquisate of Bodonitsa was a state of the Frankish Greece, located in present-day Mendenitsa, Phthiotis, following the conquests of the Fourth Crusade. It was originally granted as a margravial holding of Guy Pallavicini by Boniface, first king of Thessalonica, in 1204. Its original purpose was to guard the pass of Thermopylae.
